summary: Ardent agents through Magnus: sessions, unbuffered task event streams and streamed artifacts; New Agent deployment as a durable, resumable, audited operation; per-agent HiveMem credentials for new and existing profiles; and linked Oathweave service identities confined to the Ardent bridge.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HTTPS HiveMem base URL that issues per-agent credentials for Ardent New Agent and Enable HiveMem.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN
newOptionalEnv.description: HiveMem token with admin:agents that enrolls and rotates Ardent agent credentials.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_WORKSPACE_ID
newOptionalEnv.description: Existing HiveMem workspace Ardent agents join.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_AGENT_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HiveMem base URL written into Ardent profile configs when agents reach HiveMem at another address.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_HIVEMEM_CREDENTIAL_HOURS
newOptionalEnv.description: Lifetime of an Ardent agent HiveMem credential, 1 to 720 hours (default 720).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_ARDENT_EMBERPATH_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: OpenAI-compatible Emberpath base URL used for an Ardent agent's Emberpath model alias.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_ARDENT_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES
newOptionalEnv.description: Largest Ardent artifact the agent streams, in bytes (default 64 MiB).
